description: A backup schedule; the passphrase is never returned

modified_on.description: When the schedule was last changed.

owner_user_id.description: The administrator scheduled runs are logged under

name.description: Unique name (case insensitive); shown in the list of stored backups as a badge on the schedule's files.

enabled.description: Whether the schedule makes backups; a paused one keeps its settings and files.

frequency.description: hours: every every_hours hours; daily: every day at time; weekly: on weekday at time; monthly: on month_day at time.

every_hours.description: Hours between runs (1 to 24); only for frequency hours, else null.

time.description: Time of day, HH:MM in the container time zone; null for frequency hours.

month_day.description: Day of the month (1 to 28); only for frequency monthly, else null.

types.description: The parts the schedule backs up, as in the types list of POST /backups.

protection.description: passphrase: secrets included, encrypted with the stored passphrase; instance_key: secrets included, encrypted with this instance's key (restores only here); none: no secrets, not encrypted.

keep.description: How many files of this schedule are kept; after a successful run older ones are deleted.

next_run_at.description: When the next run is due; null while the schedule is paused.

last_run_at.description: When the last run started; null before the first run.

last_status.description: Result of the last run; null before the first run.

last_error.description: The error of the last run when it failed.

last_file.description: Name of the file of the last successful run.

last_size.description: Size in bytes of that file.

last_duration_ms.description: How long the last run took, in milliseconds.

passphrase_set.description: Whether a passphrase is stored for the schedule.

file_count.description: Stored files of the schedule; null when the backups folder cannot be listed
